referenceReview.boundary: PlayFlow, Nakama, Firebase, and Supabase remain reference-only, with no reference API, source, dependency, or wire contract copied. Agones is no longer reference-only: its client loop shape (sdks/csharp/sdk/AgonesSDK.cs and sdks/unity/AgonesSdk.cs at v1.60.0, commit 67b44a783218f7811084adaa5d9b334fb28e44ba) is adopted under Apache-2.0 as a marked modified derivative in Yogabase.Yogabase.RuntimeHost and its Unity package, retargeted to Yogabase's own self-scoped runtime-host routes. No Agones name, proto/sdk wire contract, resource concept, or host-port policy was adopted. The unmodified licence ships at licenses/Apache-2.0-Agones.txt; the full copying boundary is recorded in docs/REFERENCE_REVIEW.md

contract.mirroredFrom: Byte-identical to the product document on main at b04dcd42 (2026-09-22), as are the builds, delivery and runtime-host documents below. It carries the player-facing /v1/servers/* game-server surface, the requested-only realtime-presence capability row with its X-Yogabase-Accept-Capabilities request header, and no /v1/data/* route, Data* schema, or data-rest capability id: the client Data API's restoration was decided on 2026-09-17 and is not in the product contract yet.

buildsContract.notGeneratedReason: A developer-tool surface (Unity Editor, CLI, CI) reached with a project-scoped ybt_ developer token, not a shipped-client surface. The .NET YogabaseBuildsClient and the Unity package implement it by hand; no other language needs a client for it yet, so none is generated.

runtimeHostContract.notGeneratedReason: The document declares instance-addressed paths (/instances/{instanceId}/...), but a hosted workload calls the self-scoped relay routes /runtime-host/v1/self/{heartbeat,ready,reserve,shutdown,assignments} and never learns or asserts its own instance id. Generating from this document would emit the wrong surface for a workload, so it is checked in and checksum-verified as the server-side reference for lifecycle states and error codes only; the workload module is hand-authored.
